source.section: Section 11 — Switches routers and a packet journey

questions.sentence: A switch learns the ___ MAC address from each incoming frame.
hints: The sender observed on the ingress port.
questions.explanation: The learned association points toward the source interface.

source.section: Section 11 — Switches routers and a packet journey

questions.sentence: An unknown unicast is normally ___ within its eligible VLAN ports.
hints: It is sent out more than one eligible port.
questions.explanation: Flooding sends the frame through eligible ports in the VLAN while excluding the ingress port.

source.section: Section 10 — Ethernet Wi Fi and the physical medium

questions.sentence: Ethernet uses an error-detection trailer called the ___.
questions.explanation: The frame check sequence carries a CRC used to detect accidental corruption of the local frame.

source.section: Section 10 — Ethernet Wi Fi and the physical medium

source.section: Section 10 — Ethernet Wi Fi and the physical medium

questions.sentence: The ordinary maximum Ethernet payload MTU in these examples is ___ bytes.
hints: The standard non-jumbo payload limit used here.
questions.explanation: IP packet sizing must respect the link MTU.

source.section: Section 10 — Ethernet Wi Fi and the physical medium

questions.sentence: An untagged Ethernet header is ___ bytes and its FCS adds ___ bytes.
questions.explanation: The MAC-frame overhead here is 18 bytes, excluding preamble and spacing.

source.section: Section 11 — Switches routers and a packet journey

questions.sentence: A forwarding router decrements IPv4 TTL, whereas a conventional Ethernet ___ does not.
questions.explanation: The switch is not an IP forwarding hop.

source.section: Section 11 — Switches routers and a packet journey

questions.sentence: The next routed Ethernet link uses new source and destination ___ addresses.
questions.explanation: Endpoint IP addresses remain unchanged under the no-NAT assumption.

source.section: Section 11 — Switches routers and a packet journey

questions.sentence: The table mapping names to cached records belongs to DNS; the table mapping MAC addresses to ports belongs to a ___.
questions.explanation: These caches and databases have different keys and purposes.

source.section: Section 10 — Ethernet Wi Fi and the physical medium

questions.sentence: The AP is the immediate radio ___ in a station-to-AP Wi-Fi transmission.
hints: The endpoint that hears this local wireless frame.
questions.explanation: The network-layer destination can be a remote host.

source.section: Section 10 — Ethernet Wi Fi and the physical medium

questions.sentence: Classic shared-medium Ethernet uses CSMA/CD; Wi-Fi primarily uses collision ___.
questions.explanation: Wireless channel access relies on sensing and backoff, with local acknowledgments for common unicast traffic.

source.section: Section 10 — Ethernet Wi Fi and the physical medium

questions.sentence: Increasing link bit rate reduces ___ delay for a fixed frame size.
hints: The time needed to serialize its bits.
questions.explanation: Propagation over an unchanged path depends on signal travel speed and distance.
